method: Whitespace-delimited occurrence counts; conservative overlapping source attributions retained. Machine metadata and literal original data are separate from authored prose. Rendered HTML is an exact derived mirror, not a second authored occurrence.
mirror_policy: The raw archive has no duplicate review prose. Public source-use contains counts only. Metadata titles and source locations are machine data.
followup_policy: Every changed or new biological source span is charged, including notes, questions, reference prose and access note. Machine query records, identifiers, URLs and workflow disposition prose are not attributed primary narrative. Prior notes remain included; rendered HTML is one derived mirror.
followup_v2_policy: All changed scientific prose recharged at each actual placement; original-access URL and line ranges are provenance data. Prior public reply remains workflow disposition only; its text is archived privately. No new quotation or scientific statement in the proposed reply/body.
standing_instruction_followup: Seven existing HuRI reason placements revised and recounted; project-policy workflow notes introduce no additional source-derived biological claim.
